descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S23 「靠阅读核对 ready for qa 的说法：托管的 Privacy Policy、Terms of Use 和 BAA，以及原生 Face ID / keychain 插件（TFA-92570 AC 3）」 Ready-for-qa claims checked by reading: the hosted Privacy Policy, Terms of Use and BAA, and the native Face ID / keychain plugins (TFA-92570 AC 3)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 On first sign-in, before any AI feature can be used, one agreements screen shows: the AI consent, links to the Terms of Use and the BAA, and two checkboxes (the agreement and the authorization attest …（UAT OAT-01 step 7；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94700 AC 7；TFA-94700 AC 8；TFA-94700 AC 9；TFA-94700 AC 11；UAT 3.3）
  • T11 Settings shows the signed-in physician's email, Sign out, Privacy Policy, Delete account, a Support contact and the app version, the same way in Hospital and in Nursing Home. …（TFA-94700 AC 1；TFA-94700 AC 3；TFA-94700 AC 7）
  • T13 In the native apps, Face ID / fingerprint and secure keychain storage work through Capacitor plugins.（TFA-92570 AC 3）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given The deployed build's agreements screen and Settings (or the URLs in the legalAgreements row and PRIVACY_POLICY_URL), opened signed out in an ordinary browser; main e02167f's package.json, ios/App/App/Info.plist and Android manifest

When Open Privacy Policy, Terms of Use and BAA from the screens; note each HTTP status and the document it shows. List the Capacitor plugins and look for NSFaceIDUsageDescription in the build.

Then Each link answers 200 when signed out and opens the named document, not a placeholder or a 404. The build carries a biometric plugin, a secure-storage plugin and NSFaceIDUsageDescription.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U7 (step 7: links to the Terms of Use and the BAA) and T11 (TFA-94700 AC 3: Privacy Policy opens the public policy page): a 404 or a placeholder = 'Fail (known: Vikram's documents pending, Daniela 2026-10-05)', unless Q16 says a placeholder passes at UAT time. …

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 DOC · 文档核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：DOC · 文档核对；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：code-review。
